_comment: Central tunables for the Q-GPT Locust rig. Every capacity-calculator knob lives here so retuning never touches code. Values marked TODO are placeholders (Onyx defaults / assumptions) to confirm against staging before the first real run.
_host_note: API host only. The functional suite's base_url ends in /app, which is the SPA frontend; the REST API is served from the root /api. TODO CONFIRM.

auth._mode_note: 'session' = POST credentials, reuse the returned cookie. 'api_key' = send a static bearer token (Onyx supports API keys). TODO CONFIRM which staging accepts.
auth._creds_note: Credentials come from environment variables, never committed here. Falls back to data/input_data.json valid_login only if the env vars are unset (dev convenience).

model._note: When stub_model is true the send payload requests stub_model_name so you measure YOUR infra, not OpenRouter latency/cost. The backend must map that name to a cheap/mock model. TODO CONFIRM the mechanism (model override field vs. header).

pacing._note: Think-time between a user's prompts. Tune to the real per-session prompt cadence for S01 baseline-sessions realism.

timeouts._stream_note: Max time to hold a streamed reply open. Observed range in the functional run was 10s..391s, so 420s leaves headroom. Feeds S08 held-stream duration.

mix_percent._note: S12 mix table. Used directly as Locust task weights. Should sum to ~100. TODO ALIGN with the real mix table before drawing capacity conclusions.

scenario_params._conversation_note: S02 conversation-history multiplier: turns replayed in one session to amplify input tokens.
scenario_params._file_note: S04/S05 average file size per prompt (light ~50KB, heavy ~5MB). TODO ALIGN with real corpus.
scenario_params._rag_note: S03 retrieved chunks per prompt; drives RAG context tokens and vector-search QPS.
scenario_params._agentic_note: S06/S07 expected MCP/tool calls per agentic prompt. Observed 1..17 in the functional run, so treat as a distribution, not a constant.

endpoints._note: Onyx (formerly Danswer) default API surface. EVERY path here is a placeholder to confirm via a browser Network capture on staging (send one prompt, upload one file, run one doc query).
